faqs.title: Murphi.ai FAQs | Healthcare AI Platform Questions Answered
faqs.description: Find answers to frequently asked questions about Murphi.ai's AI healthcare platform, clinical documentation, billing automation, and HIPAA compliance.
faqs.heroSub: Everything you need to know about Murphi.ai — platform, integration, modules, security, and getting started.

items.question: What is Murphi.ai?
items.answer: Murphi.ai is an AI-native platform built for U.S. healthcare. It automates four workflows — clinical documentation, patient collections, compliance reporting, and contract analysis — inside the systems providers, EHR platforms, and RCM companies already use. Operated by Deskfactors Inc., headquartered in Durham, North Carolina.

items.question: Who operates Murphi.ai?
items.answer: Murphi.ai is operated by Deskfactors Inc., headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, USA, with a development center in Bangalore, India.

items.question: Is Murphi.ai a point solution or a platform?
items.answer: It's a platform. Four live modules — Ambient AI, Patient Collections, Revenue Assurance, and Contract Analyzer — all under one integration. Deploy one or all four. Each runs inside your existing EHR without a rip-and-replace.

items.question: What care settings does Murphi.ai support?
items.answer: Home Health, Hospice, Palliative Care, Primary Care, Mental and Behavioral Health, Specialty Clinics, Health Systems, and Skilled Nursing. Murphi.ai also serves EHR companies, RCM companies, coding and billing consultants, QAPI firms, and accreditation bodies.

items.question: How is Murphi.ai different from other healthcare AI tools?
items.answer: Murphi.ai is horizontal — it covers clinical documentation, patient collections, compliance reporting, and contract analysis in one platform. It's fully white-label, embeds via encrypted API in 15 days, absorbs zero token cost to partners, and holds zero data rights. Most AI tools are point solutions. Murphi.ai is infrastructure.

items.question: What is Ambient AI?
items.answer: Voice-to-note clinical documentation. Clinicians record visits and Murphi.ai generates structured clinical notes — OASIS, SOAP, PIE, BIRP, DAP, IDG — synced to the EHR before the visit ends. 98.7% transcription accuracy. 55 languages. Medication scan and handwriting capture supported. Status: Beta.

items.question: What is the Patient Collections module?
items.answer: Reads outstanding AR from your EHR. Sends a personalized SMS payment link. Patient pays via ACH, credit, debit, or QR code. Payment posts back to EHR automatically. Provider paid within 48 hours via Everyware gateway. AR cycle from 100+ days to 15. Status: Live.

items.question: What is Revenue Assurance?
items.answer: 28 AI compliance reports — 15 for Home Health (F2F, OASIS accuracy, Coding Review, ADR, PDGM, Recertification, and more) and 13 for Hospice (CTI Validator, HOPE, IDG, EOLRBA, Level of Care, and more). CHAP and ACHC aligned. 90–95% AI accuracy with structured human review workflow. Status: Beta.

items.question: What is the Contract Analyzer?
items.answer: Uploads payer contracts, generates plain-language operating manuals, and surfaces underpayments, non-compliant clauses, and reimbursement gaps. PADU Plus methodology. Includes a contract repository for managed care departments. Built for health systems and RCM companies. Status: Beta.

items.question: What modules are coming soon?
items.answer: Coming soon: Engage (HIPAA-compliant messaging), Billing & Claims Post-Acute, Billing & Claims E&M, Referral & Intake, and Credentialing.

items.question: Can I use just one module?
items.answer: Yes. Modules are independent. You can start with Patient Collections, add Ambient AI later, and never touch Contract Analyzer. One integration covers all four when you're ready.

items.question: How does the PaaS model work?
items.answer: EHR and RCM companies embed any Murphi.ai module into their platform via encrypted REST API, SSO, or iFrame. Fully white-labeled — your logo, your UI, your pricing, your customers. Murphi.ai is invisible infrastructure. Zero token cost to you.

items.question: How long does integration take?
items.answer: Most integrations go live in 15 days via API, SSO, or iFrame. Complex EHR integrations with custom workflows typically range from 4 to 12 weeks. Our team stays hands-on through every step.

items.question: Which EHRs could Murphi potentially integrate with?
items.answer: Post-Acute EHRs: WellSky, Axxess, Kantime, MatrixCare, HCHB, Netsmart, Careficient. Health System EHRs: Epic, Cerner (Oracle Health), Athena, ECW, Allscripts, NextGen. Any EHR supporting FHIR R4 or HL7 v2 can be integrated via Agentic AI, RPA, or Direct API.

items.question: What integration methods are supported?
items.answer: Agentic AI (autonomous EHR navigation), RPA (robotic process automation), FHIR R4, HL7 v2, and Direct REST API. Carefluence FHIR adapter (current partner) and Rhapsody (available) for third-party adapter paths.

items.question: What does zero token cost mean?
items.answer: Murphi.ai absorbs all AI infrastructure and token costs. PaaS partners pay a platform fee — not per-token charges that erode margins as usage grows. Your cost is fully predictable regardless of usage scale.

items.question: Who owns the data?
items.answer: You do. All input and output data belongs entirely to you and your customers. Murphi.ai holds zero data rights — contractually guaranteed in every agreement.

items.question: Is Murphi.ai HIPAA compliant?
items.answer: Yes. Full HIPAA compliance with BAA executed at onboarding for every customer. All PHI encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+). Zero-trust architecture. PHI never transmitted unencrypted.

items.question: What certifications does Murphi.ai hold?
items.answer: HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and ISO 27001 certified. Security documentation including SOC 2 report, penetration test results, and ISO certificate available under NDA on request.

items.question: Does Murphi.ai train AI models on customer data?
items.answer: No. Customer data is never used to train foundational AI models. All data remains completely isolated from model development. This is contractually guaranteed in every customer and partner agreement.

items.question: Is a BAA available?
items.answer: Yes. A fully executed Business Associate Agreement is available for every Murphi.ai customer and covers all services, integrations, and data processing activities.

items.question: What cloud infrastructure does Murphi.ai use?
items.answer: Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Geo-redundancy with regional failover ensures continuous availability.

items.question: What does zero token cost mean for PaaS partners?
items.answer: Murphi.ai absorbs all AI infrastructure and token costs. Partners pay a platform fee — not per-token charges that grow with usage. Margins stay predictable as your customer base scales.

items.question: Is Murphi.ai white-label capable?
items.answer: Yes, fully. Your logo, your UI, your pricing, your customer relationships. Customers never see Murphi.ai — they see your product, enhanced by AI.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Visit our Contact Us page and our team will respond within one business day. We'll understand your care setting, EHR environment, and modules of interest — then map out a deployment plan tailored to your organization.
